name: The Videre Elixir
summary: Gregan Brewspewer will make you a Videre Elixir, but only once an Evoroot is brought. Gregan also claims a great many things are known to him about herbs and alchemy.

sections.title: An Evoroot for the Brewer
sections.body: Gregan Brewspewer can make you a Videre Elixir as soon as an Evoroot is put in hand. Meanwhile Gregan boasts of knowing a great many things about herbs and alchemy, and begins a story about turning the cheese meant for lunch into gold, only to ask where you are going when you walk off. Gregan is the one to ask about where an Evoroot can be found.

sections.title: When the Evoroot Arrives
sections.body: When you come back with the Evoroot, Gregan greets you by saying you pulled a fast one on old Miblon.

aliases: where do i get videre elixir
faq.answer: Gregan Brewspewer, once you bring an Evoroot.

faq.q: What ingredient is required to make the elixir?
faq.answer: An Evoroot. Gregan can tell you where to find one.

faq.q: What does Gregan Brewspewer boast about?
faq.answer: Gregan boasts of knowing a great many things about herbs and alchemy, and starts a story about turning a lunchtime cheese into gold.
